topic: freshness must not refetch on reconnect
lesson: use-freshness.ts:7 sets retry: false and refetchOnWindowFocus: false but leaves TanStack Query's refetchOnReconnect at its DEFAULT of true, so the pill silently refetches when connectivity returns - exactly the silent retry t-ass-c5 forbids ('never silently retries or shows an unqualified cached value'). Raised by both the quality and performance lenses. Add refetchOnReconnect: false. Cover it with an assertion on the query options so the default cannot creep back, and keep gcTime: 0 so no unqualified cached value survives.
